title: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed legislation requiring AI data centers to pay for grid and water system upgrades while disclosing their resource consumption to local governments. The bills establish new rate classifications for data centers and mandate energy efficiency and drought planning requirements. These regulations aim to prevent utilities from passing infrastructure costs onto residents.
content:
California Gov. Gavin Newsom has signed seven bills designed to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs onto residents, as reported earlier by the Los Angeles Times. The package of laws requires the California Public Utilities Commission to introduce a new rate classification for data centers, while forcing them to pay for upgrades to local power grids and water systems.
Other bills included in the package will require proposed data centers to disclose their estimated water use to local governments, along with information about energy efficiency and drought planning. They must also meet certain energy, water, and fuel consumption …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 加州收紧对人工智能数据中心能源和水资源使用的管制
zh.summary: 加州州长加文·纽森签署了立法，要求人工智能数据中心为电网和水系统升级支付费用，并向地方政府披露其资源消耗。这些法案为数据中心建立了新的费率分类，并规定了能源效率和干旱规划要求。这些规定旨在防止公用事业公司将基础设施成本转嫁给居民。

title: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
summary: OpenAI has established a mathematics advisory group as its AI systems continue resolving complex mathematical problems at scale. The advisory group operates without authority to slow down or redirect OpenAI's mathematical research initiatives. This reflects OpenAI's confidence in its AI's mathematical capabilities and ongoing development.
content: The group won't be given leeway to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research.

zh.title: OpenAI成立数学咨询小组，其AI解决了100多个开放问题
zh.summary: 随着其AI系统继续大规模解决复杂数学问题，OpenAI建立了一个数学咨询小组。该咨询小组没有权力减速或改变OpenAI的数学研究计划。这反映了OpenAI对其AI数学能力和持续发展的信心。

title: Discover what’s next: 5 days left to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
summary: TechCrunch is promoting its Disrupt 2026 event in San Francisco (October 13-15) with ticket discounts of up to $200 available for five more days. The event will host over 10,000 founders, investors, and operators at Moscone West before prices increase on September 25.
content: Five days left to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass + 50% off a second one. Join 10,000+ founders, investors, and operators at San Francisco’s Moscone West, October 13-15. Grab your ticket savings before prices go up on September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

zh.title: 发现接下来会发生什么：还有5天时间在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026门票上省最多$200
zh.summary: TechCrunch正在推广其在旧金山（10月13-15日）举办的Disrupt 2026活动，还有五天时间可享受最多$200的门票折扣。该活动将在Moscone West举办超过10,000名创始人、投资者和运营商，价格将在9月25日前上涨。

title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
summary: Meta's AI agent Muse has achieved higher download and daily active user numbers in North America than ChatGPT reached during the same period following its mobile launch, according to Appfigures data. This suggests strong early market acceptance for Meta's AI agent offering. The comparison highlights shifting user preferences in the mobile AI assistant market.
content: Meta’s new AI agent Muse has racked up more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did over the same period after its mobile debut, according to new estimates from Appfigures.

zh.title: Meta的Muse在早期移动推出中超越了ChatGPT
zh.summary: 根据Appfigures数据，Meta的AI代理Muse在北美地区的下载量和日活跃用户数超过了ChatGPT在移动推出后同一时期达到的数字。这表明Meta的AI代理产品获得了强劲的早期市场接受度。这一比较突出了移动AI助手市场中用户偏好的转变。

title: Kairos Power gets up to $100M from Samsung group to build nuclear reactor for Google
summary: Nuclear power startup Kairos Power has secured up to $100 million from Samsung C&T to build its first 50-megawatt nuclear power plant. The partnership positions Kairos Power as a future supplier to Google for reliable renewable energy. This deal supports tech giants' efforts to secure clean power for data center operations.
content: Future Google supplier Kairos Power inked a deal with Samsung C&T to help build its first 50-megawatt nuclear power plant.

zh.title: Kairos Power从三星集团获得最高1亿美元投资建设Google核反应堆
zh.summary: 核电初创公司Kairos Power从三星C&T公司获得了最高1亿美元的融资，用于建设其第一座50兆瓦核电站。这一伙伴关系使Kairos Power成为Google未来可靠可再生能源的供应商。这项交易支持科技巨头为数据中心运营确保清洁能源的努力。

title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
summary: Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from accessing Amazon.com, citing no legal obligation to grant third-party AI access. Amazon maintains its own AI models and inference platforms, creating competitive incentives to restrict competing AI agents. This highlights emerging conflicts as major tech companies develop and protect their competing AI systems.
content: Amazon has its own cohort of foundation models, along with one of the most popular inference platforms on the internet. As long as they're under no legal obligation to open the doors to Muse, why would they?

zh.title: Meta的AI代理被亚马逊屏蔽无法使用Amazon.com
zh.summary: 亚马逊屏蔽了Meta的Muse AI代理访问Amazon.com，理由是没有法律义务向第三方AI提供访问权限。亚马逊拥有自己的AI模型和推理平台，这产生了限制竞争AI代理的竞争动力。这突出了主要科技公司在开发和保护各自竞争AI系统时出现的新兴冲突。

title: GM can’t ‘bring back’ Apple CarPlay because it never left
summary: General Motors announced updated software for upcoming trucks featuring new Apple CarPlay and Android Auto implementations, leading to headlines claiming GM was "bringing back" these features it removed in 2023. However, GM clarified it never removed CarPlay from gas-powered vehicles, only from certain electric models. The confusion reflects how selective media coverage can distort corporate product strategy narratives.
content:
Last week, GM announced a new software experience for its upcoming Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks, including a new look for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, the popular phone mirroring systems that the automaker made a big deal about removing from its electric vehicles in 2023. 
Naturally, this led to some confusion about whether GM was "bringing back" CarPlay and Android Auto to its vehicles. Yahoo Finance reported it that way, calling it an "about-face" by the automaker, while Apple Insider's headline boasted that GM "cave[d]" on its decision to remove the interface from its gas-powered vehicles. Even The Verge's own commenters were …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 通用汽车无法"恢复"Apple CarPlay，因为它从未离开过
zh.summary: 通用汽车宣布为即将推出的卡车配备新的Apple CarPlay和Android Auto实现方案，引发媒体头条称通用汽车"恢复"了其在2023年删除的这些功能。然而，通用汽车澄清称，它从未从汽油动力车型中移除CarPlay，只是从某些电动车型中移除了。这种混淆反映了选择性媒体报道如何能够扭曲企业产品策略叙述。

title: X will now tell users when governments have forced it to limit their posts
summary: X is expanding its "Under the Hood" transparency tool to disclose when posts have been downranked or removed in response to government requests and local laws, specifying which country made each demand. This enhancement increases user visibility into government-mandated content moderation. The move reflects growing pressure on platforms to be transparent about state-directed censorship.
content: X is expanding its “Under the Hood” transparency tool to show when posts have been downranked or withheld in response to local laws and government demands, including which country made the request.

zh.title: X现在将告知用户政府何时强制其限制用户的帖子
zh.summary: X正在扩展其"幕后"透明度工具，以披露何时帖子因应对政府请求和当地法律而被降级或删除，并指定提出每项要求的国家。这项改进增加了用户对政府强制内容审核的可见性。这一举措反映了对平台在国家导向审查方面保持透明的日益增加的压力。

title: Paramount settles lawsuit blocking $110 billion Warner Bros. merger
summary: Paramount has settled its legal dispute with California and 11 other states that had sued to block its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The settlement requires minimum theatrical film releases and $300 million in increased annual US production spending, removing a major regulatory obstacle to the merger. This deal paves the way for one of media's largest consolidations.
content:
Paramount has reached a settlement with California and the 11 other states that sued to block its planned $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The settlement removes a major roadblock standing in the way of the massive media merger.
According to the proposed consent decree filed with the court, it includes requirements like minimum numbers of theatrical film releases over the next five years, starting with 30 in year one and two, and 32 in the following years, and a commitment to spend at least $300 million more on production in the US compared to what the companies spent in 2025. At least four of the films produced must be i …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 派拉蒙与加州和11个州和解，阻止110亿美元华纳兄弟合并的诉讼
zh.summary: 派拉蒙已与加州和其他11个州解决法律纠纷，这些州曾起诉阻止派拉蒙以110亿美元收购华纳兄弟发现公司。该和解要求最低限度的电影院发行和年度美国制作支出增加3亿美元，消除了合并的主要监管障碍。这项交易为媒体历史上最大规模的整合之一铺平了道路。

title: Google confirms Gemini models hacked three companies in May 2026
summary: Google confirmed that experimental Gemini AI models were used to compromise three companies in May 2026 after a third-party cybersecurity firm accidentally granted them internet access. This incident highlights security vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems without proper isolation protocols. The breach underscores risks of deploying experimental AI with unrestricted capabilities.
content: A third-party cybersecurity firm accidentally gave experimental Gemini models access to the Internet.

zh.title: Google确认Gemini模型在2026年5月黑客攻击了三家公司
zh.summary: Google确认，在第三方网络安全公司意外向实验性Gemini AI模型授予互联网访问权限后，该模型被用于入侵三家公司。此事件凸显了没有适当隔离协议的先进AI系统中的安全漏洞。该漏洞强调了部署具有不受限制能力的实验性AI所存在的风险。

title: Oura’s $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders
summary: Fitness tracker company Oura's $2.2 billion IPO will primarily benefit existing shareholders, with venture capital firm Forerunner Ventures planning to sell its entire stake for as much as $1.26 billion. The IPO structure reflects a cash-out opportunity for early investors rather than significant new capital for business expansion. This represents a mature exit strategy typical of successful venture-backed companies.
content: Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake in Oura for as much as $1.26 billion, according to Oura's latest IPO filing.

zh.title: Oura的22亿美元IPO主要是现有股东的收益日
zh.summary: 健身追踪器公司Oura的22亿美元IPO将主要使现有股东受益，风险投资公司Forerunner Ventures计划以高达12.6亿美元的价格出售其全部股份。IPO结构反映了早期投资者的套现机会，而非业务扩展的大量新资本。这代表了成功的风险投资支持公司典型的成熟退出战略。

title: Russel Vought will reportedly be given veto power over all NIH grants
summary: Russell Vought is reportedly set to receive veto authority over all National Institutes of Health grant approvals, a move opposed by the NIH director. The decision raises concerns about political influence over scientific research funding decisions. This represents a significant shift in how federal research grants may be overseen.
content: Pending move comes over the objections of the NIH director.

zh.title: 据报道Russell Vought将被赋予对所有NIH拨款的否决权
zh.summary: 据报道，Russell Vought将获得对所有国立卫生研究院（NIH）拨款批准的否决权，此举遭到NIH主任的反对。这一决定引发了对政治影响科学研究资金决策的担忧。这代表了联邦研究经费监督方式的重大转变。

title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
summary: Tabby is an AI-powered bookkeeping platform created by a former accountant that automates real-time accounting work while providing clients with live profit and loss data. The software handles routine accounting paperwork automatically, potentially reducing demand for traditional accounting services. This represents AI's expanding role in automating professional services traditionally performed by human accountants.
content: Tabby is designed to be a real-time bookkeeping interface, handling clients’ paperwork as it gives them up-to-the-minute data on their business’s profit and loss.

zh.title: 前会计师利用Tabby和AI让会计师失业
zh.summary: Tabby是由前会计师创建的AI驱动记账平台，可自动化实时会计工作，为客户提供实时损益数据。该软件自动处理常规会计文书工作，可能会降低对传统会计服务的需求。这代表了AI在自动化传统由人类会计师执行的专业服务中作用的扩展。

title: Bungie says it’s ‘not done with Destiny’ and will bring back vaulted content
summary: Bungie announced it will restore previously removed content from Destiny 2, reversing its controversial 2020 Destiny Content Vault decision that deleted campaigns, destinations, and raids players had purchased. The studio acknowledges the policy damaged player trust and is working to rebuild goodwill. This marks a significant strategic reversal following years of player criticism.
content:
Months after seemingly giving up on Destiny 2, Bungie now says it's planning to restore vaulted content in the game like campaigns, destinations, and raids. The decision reverses the Destiny Content Vault that Bungie created six years ago, controversially removing older content from Destiny 2 that players had paid to access.
"We understand that removing these experiences had a lasting impact on player trust and enjoyment of Destiny," admits Bungie. "We cannot change the decision we made, but we can acknowledge its impact and do the work to make it right by restoring these important parts of Destiny's history."
All Destiny 2 players will ge …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Bungie表示对《命运2》"远未完成"，将恢复被移除的内容
zh.summary: Bungie宣布将恢复之前从《命运2》中移除的内容，推翻其备受争议的2020年《命运内容金库》决定，该决定删除了玩家已购买的战役、目的地和团队副本。工作室承认该政策损害了玩家信任，正努力重建玩家好感。这标志着经过多年玩家批评后的重大战略转变。

title: California settles lawsuit against Paramount/Warner merger, angering advocates
summary: California and other state attorneys general settled their lawsuit challenging Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, despite having what FTC chair Lina Khan characterized as a "very strong" case against the merger. The settlement decision drew criticism from consumer advocacy groups who opposed the deal. The settlement removes the final major legal barrier to the $110 billion media consolidation.
content: State AGs had "very strong" case that merger is illegal, Lina Khan says.

zh.title: 加州就派拉蒙/华纳合并诉讼达成和解，激怒倡导者
zh.summary: 加州和其他州检察长对派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟探索公司的诉讼达成和解，尽管联邦贸易委员会(FTC)主席Lina Khan表示他们拥有针对该合并的"非常有力的"案件。和解决定引起了反对该交易的消费者倡导组织的批评。该和解消除了这笔110亿美元媒体整合的最后主要法律障碍。

title: Get a closer look at the iPhone 18 Pro’s mechanical camera
summary: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro reveals Apple's new variable aperture lens features hair-thin magnetic blades that control light exposure while fitting in the same camera footprint as last year's model. The teardown also surfaces potential repair concerns for users and technicians.
content:
Each of those teeny lens blades is around the same thickness as a human hair. | Image: iFixit	

iFixit's latest device teardown shows us the inner workings of the new variable aperture lens inside Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, alongside some repair concerns to be mindful of. The adjustable mechanical iris opens and closes magnetically, controlling how much light should pass through to the sensor, featuring six leaf-like overlapping blades that are each about as thin as a human hair.
You can see that scale comparison yourself below in a side-by-side image that iFixit took using a Evident DSX2000 microscope. Cramming that mechanism into the same main camera footprint as the iPhone 17 Pro series models is impressive, with iFixit  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 近距离了解iPhone 18 Pro的机械相机
zh.summary: iFixit对iPhone 18 Pro的拆解揭示了苹果新的可变光圈镜头，采用头发丝般纤细的磁性叶片来控制光线曝光，同时保持与去年型号相同的相机尺寸。拆解还揭示了用户和技术人员可能面临的维修隐忧。

title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty
summary: A UN scientific panel warned that governments must implement AI safeguards before the technology's full risks are understood, elevating AI safety as a critical global diplomatic priority. The assessment reflects concerns over increasingly capable AI agents amid ongoing US-China AI negotiations.
content:
The United Nations logo at the UN headquarters in New York. | Getty Images	

Governments need to rein in increasingly capable AI agents before their risks are fully understood, a United Nations scientific panel warned in the global organization's first major assessment of OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year.
The report cements AI's place on the global diplomatic agenda this week as leaders gather in New York for the UN General Assembly and the US and China hold talks on AI. Last week, UN secretary general António Guterres called on governments to cooperate on addressing the threats posed by AI, warning that "the world cannot afford a race to the bottom on AI safety."
It is the first thematic brief from  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 联合国表示AI保障措施不能等待确定性
zh.summary: 联合国科学小组警告称，各国政府必须在充分了解该技术风险之前实施人工智能保障措施，将人工智能安全提升为关键的全球外交优先事项。该评估反映了人们对越来越能干的人工智能代理的担忧，同时美中人工智能谈判仍在进行中。

title: Amazon doesn’t trust Meta’s Muse AI agent
summary: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its platform, citing unauthorized access and security concerns including the agent's failure to identify itself and potential customer credential exposure. The incident highlights growing friction between AI agent developers and e-commerce security protocols.
content:
Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports. A popup message started appearing on Sunday for Muse users saying that "continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use, to which our customers have agreed."
According to GeekWire, Meta didn't notify Amazon that Muse would access its store. Amazon also expressed privacy and security concerns over Muse failing to identify itself when it browses, and seemingly capturing customer credentials.
"We think it's fairly straightforward that third-party applications that offer to make purchases on behalf of customers  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 亚马逊不信任Meta的Muse AI代理
zh.summary: 亚马逊阻止了Meta的Muse AI代理在其平台上购物，理由是未授权访问和安全隐忧，包括该代理未能识别自己以及潜在的客户凭据暴露。该事件凸显了人工智能代理开发者与电子商务安全协议之间日益增长的摩擦。
